builderio/agent-native.caption:
What if your AI agent could actually use professional software instead of just telling you what to click? 👀

This is the idea behind CLI-Anything. It helps turn software like Blender, GIMP, LibreOffice and other applications into command-line tools that AI agents can use to perform real tasks.
